Standard Sourcing Options
Board Thickness
Nominal rigid-board thickness options: 1.5 / 2.0 / 2.5 / 3.0 mm. Request the board grade, gsm and measured thickness separately; gsm is not a universal thickness conversion.
Wrap Substrate
Art paper (157gsm/128gsm), Kraft paper, Duplex, Velvet board, Suede, Linen, Leatherette, Textured Paper
Magnet Grade
Concealed magnets sized to the lid weight and target closure feel; placement and pull strength confirmed on the approved sample
Common Sizes
Custom dimensions. Nominal planning examples: 12 x 12 x 5 cm, 22 x 16 x 8 cm and 35 x 25 x 10 cm. Confirm usable interior versus closed exterior and approve the loaded sample.

Soft-touch matte lamination, gloss lamination, spot UV, embossing, debossing, foil stamping
Printing Support
Offset CMYK full-color bleed, Pantone PMS spot colour match, screen printing; confirm the selected ink system and any environmental claim
Custom Inserts

From 100 pcs per custom size (collapsible magnetic boxes from 300 pcs); confirmed on the quote after the structure, finish and insert are reviewed

3–5 business days for a physical sample

12–15 days after sample approval, plus freight time to your destination

sections.heading: What should buyers specify before choosing a magnetic rigid box manufacturer?
sections.text: Buyer Answer What should buyers specify before choosing a magnetic rigid box manufacturer? Start with the product size and weight, the opening direction, insert material, wrap paper, print coverage and finish. These choices determine board strength, magnet placement, hinge behavior, packing method and shipping volume. A factory comparison should use the same approved specification. Ask each supplier to confirm sample scope, insert clearance, color tolerance, inspection checkpoints and delivery terms so that a lower quote is not hiding a different construction. Follow the packaging color-matching approval workflow to set proof approvals before bulk production. For due diligence, review our factory workflow , certification records and packaging cases . The guide on verifying a China packaging factory provides a practical supplier checklist.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Production Process
sections.text: Factory SOP Step-by-Step Production Process 1️⃣ Engineering Review An engineering review checks dimensions, weight, opening direction, insert, artwork and closure requirements. Any gaps or construction risks should be confirmed in writing before sampling. 2️⃣ Quoted Sample Route The quoted sample route should state whether it covers a white sample, printed proof or fully finished sample, plus its cost, review scope and agreed timing. 3️⃣ Approval & In-Process Checks Keep a signed approval record for the accepted sample and use named in-process checks for board, wrap, magnet, insert, colour and finish before bulk production begins. 4️⃣ Packing & Freight Confirmation Confirm units per carton, carton dimensions, gross weight, protective packing, destination and Incoterm before selecting sea, air or courier delivery.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.text: Questions Frequently Asked Questions What is a magnetic rigid box? A magnetic rigid box is a wrapped greyboard presentation box with concealed magnets in the closing flap. It is used when a buyer needs a sturdy, reusable structure and a controlled premium reveal. How should I compare magnetic rigid box manufacturers? Compare the approved sample, board and wrap specification, magnet alignment, insert fit, color tolerance, inspection checkpoints and delivery scope. Ask the supplier to state these items in the quotation instead of comparing unit price alone. What changes the price of a custom magnetic rigid box? Price changes with finished dimensions, board and wrap grade, magnet configuration, insert material, print coverage, finishing steps, quantity and shipping terms. A reliable quote needs these specifications before a unit price is confirmed. Which inserts and finishes are available for magnetic gift boxes? Common insert routes include EVA foam, paperboard, molded pulp and velvet-wrapped trays. Finish options include foil stamping, embossing, spot UV and protective lamination; final compatibility is checked against the wrap paper and artwork. What should I send for a magnetic box quotation? Send the product dimensions and weight, target quantity, destination, logo artwork, preferred finish, insert requirement and launch deadline. Product photos or a physical sample help the factory check fit and propose the right structure. Is a magnetic rigid box the same as a rigid box with a magnetic flap? Yes. Buyers looking for rigid box with magnetic flap manufacturers are describing the structure on this page: a rigid board box whose lid closes onto concealed magnets in the flap. Comparing suppliers on the wording is not useful — compare them on the points covered above: board specification, insert and finish options, and what actually changes the price.
